sections.section_title: A Record of Origin Connecting Abraham, David, and the Anointed One
sections.summary: The neutral reading finds this passage is a genealogical record establishing Jesus as the convergence point of the Abrahamic and Davidic covenants, structured around the exile as a hinge point, with four boundary-crossing women signaling that God's purposes have always included the unexpected and the nations.

The neutral reading finds this passage resolves the genealogical tension by showing how Joseph's obedient act of naming legally incorporates Jesus into the Davidic line, defines his mission as salvation from sins, and frames the birth as the arrival of 'God with us.'
